# Blacklist Brewer

> A small specialty coffee stand in Phuket Old Town, Thailand, brewing V60
> filter coffee at night and a fuller menu on Sundays during Phuket Walking Street.

## Canonical

- Website: https://parkeekey.github.io/blacklistbrewer-site/
- Sitemap: https://parkeekey.github.io/blacklistbrewer-site/sitemap.xml

## What it is

- Name: Blacklist Brewer (#blacklistbrewer)
- Type: walk-up specialty coffee stand / coffee table. No seats; mostly takeaway.
- Disambiguation: a coffee stand, not a brewery, bar, or pub; not affiliated with Blacklist Brewing.
- Operation: a small, personal stand, with family help on Sundays.
- Payment: cash or PromptPay QR only. No cards.
- Visual signature: the brewer's public outfit and alter ego is a cowboy hat and glasses.
- Positioning: "The best V60 experience at night in Old Town Phuket."
- Idea: being unknown can be powerful; discovery happens through coffee and conversation.

## The method (A-E-I-O-U)

- Agile Adaptation: the table is small and mobile, built to brew well in an open street environment and changing weather.
- Experience: every run is counted (Run Day 141); the stand grows through customer feedback and local coffee competitions. Mastery comes through the course of doing.
- Independence: the stand focuses on brewing and works independently alongside roasteries and specialty cafes, rather than trying to do everything itself.
- Operational Thinking: the workflow is designed for the street, not for a cafe, choosing only the equipment and steps that fit an open, changing space.
- Understanding: coffee knowledge is updated yearly, and service reads what each guest wants without making specialty coffee feel intimidating.

## Where

- Thalang Road, Talat Yai, Mueang Phuket, Phuket, Thailand.
- Primary landmark: in front of the tunnel to Dibuk Road that connects to the Shell gas station, beside the ORTA Old Town souvenir shop.
- Coordinates: 7.884778, 98.388806
- Plus code: V9MQ+WG3 Phuket, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=7.884778,98.388806

## When

- Extended Brewing Operations: Tuesday to Saturday, 18:00-22:00. Filter / V60 only, no espresso.
- Sunday Run: Sunday, afternoon to 22:00, during Phuket Walking Street. Fuller menu.

## Menu and prices (THB)

- V60 filter coffee (hot or iced): from 160
- Premium lots: from 200
- Origins: Colombia, Ethiopia, Thai; sometimes Yemen when available
- Flavor range: sour, sweet, strong, floral
- Sunday hand-pressed espresso / Americano: from 60
- Sunday specials: Pistachio Milk Iced Latte, Coconut Mocha Iced Coffee, Macchiato, Thai Tea (AeroPress)
- On request: shaken iced coffee (a special request, not widely known)

## Equipment (drip)

- V60: the most widely known pour-over brewer; manual hand-pouring controls turbulence and flow rate for acidity.
- OREA: a modular brewing system for body and sweetness, brewed for a fuller mouthfeel.
- AeroPress: used for black coffee, especially medium to dark roasts, and for Thai Tea on the Sunday Run only.
- GX2: an experimental siphon-method system for clean, fast brewing and multiple temperature profiles; used for larger drip orders (2-3 at once) and to avoid unwanted bitterness.
- UFO V3: an 80-degree filter shape that lowers bed resistance for a more even extraction; used for hybrid-method coffee at a smaller ratio.
- We do not sell equipment. The brewers can be ordered through marketplace apps such as Lazada and Shopee; a short list of links is being prepared.

## The people

- Regulars from Saudi Arabia, Oman, Kuwait and many other Arab countries, used to a night coffee culture.
- Also welcoming Indian, Russian, Western and Asian guests curious to understand Thai coffee.
- Many guests ask for Ethiopian coffee.
- Signature line: when a customer asks "What is the best?", the answer is "You are the best."

## Associations

- The owner is the first apprentice of the owner of Sixory Coffee, a specialty cafe in Phuket Old Town.
- Beans are same or similar to Sixory, roasted by Hacking Coffee Roasters in Bangkok.
- This is an association, not an exclusive partnership; other beans may also be used.

## FAQ

- Where can I drink V60 specialty coffee in Phuket at night, when most cafes close at 5-6 PM?
  Blacklist Brewer, Tuesday to Saturday 18:00-22:00, on Thalang Road in front of the Dibuk Road tunnel near the Shell gas station.
- When is it open?
  Tue-Sat 18:00-22:00 (filter/V60 only); Sunday afternoon-22:00 (full menu).
- Where exactly is it?
  On Thalang Road, in front of the Dibuk Road tunnel near the Shell gas station. 7.884778, 98.388806; Plus code V9MQ+WG3 Phuket.
- How much is coffee?
  V60 from 160 THB; premium lots from 200 THB; Sunday espresso/Americano from 60 THB.
- Do I need to book? Are there seats?
  Walk-up only; no seats, but a small space to rest and say hello; mostly takeaway.
- Is there Ethiopian coffee?
  Yes, regularly, alongside Colombian, Thai and sometimes Yemen.
- Can I get shaken iced coffee?
  Yes, on request. It is a special request and not widely known.
- Do you sell equipment?
  No. The brewers can be ordered through marketplace apps such as Lazada and Shopee; a short list of links is being prepared.
- What is the best coffee?
  "You are the best."
- Can I pay by card?
  No. Cash or PromptPay QR only.
